about:
I am a Computer Science graduate and Cybersecurity master's student at New York University's Tandon School of Engineering. I enjoy building practical software at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, robotics, and immersive 3D experiences.

My experience includes developing generative AI solutions for financial institutions, building AR/VR applications with React and Three.js, and designing multimodal robotic sketching systems. I work with Python, C, JavaScript, SQL, React, Three.js, PyTorch, OpenCV, Flask, Firebase, and Docker.

I also co-authored **Automated Sketching with Robotic Arm: Integrating NLP for Visual Art Generation**, published at ICCRE 2026.
